rawFindings.title: Incorrect empty string path check in isHomeHelper
rawFindings.explanation: The modification changes the check 'if (!path || path === 'index.html') return true;' to 'if (this.path === '') return true;'. This removes the check for 'index.html', and also fails to consider 'undefined' or other falsy values that may indicate home. This changes the original logic and may cause false negatives for the home page detection.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the original condition: 'var path = this.path; if (!path || path === 'index.html') return true;' to correctly identify home pages with empty or 'index.html' paths.

rawFindings.title: Altered regular expression in isHomeHelper may break pagination path matching
rawFindings.explanation: The original regex '^' + escapeRegExp(paginationDir) + '\/\d+\/(index\.html)?$' matches 'paginationDir/number/' optionally ending with 'index.html'. The modified regex '^' + escapeRegExp(paginationDir) + '\/\d+\/' matches only the prefix 'paginationDir/number/' and not the optional 'index.html' or end anchor, possibly matching unintended paths or failing some cases.
rawFindings.suggestion: Use the original regex to ensure exact matching including 'index.html' suffix and end of string anchor for proper pagination path detection.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect path check for home page in isHomeHelper
rawFindings.explanation: The original code allowed empty path or 'index.html' as home page; the new code only allows empty path. This breaks identification of home page as 'index.html' path is valid home page URL in previous logic and clients may expect it.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore check to match original logic: if (!this.path || this.path === 'index.html') return true; to correctly identify 'index.html' as home page.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect strict equality check in isHomeHelper for empty path
rawFindings.explanation: The original code checked if path was falsy or equal to 'index.html' to return true, indicating the home page. The new code only checks if this.path is an empty string, which changes logic and will fail when this.path is 'index.html'. This reduces correctness, potentially disabling home detection.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the original condition to cover both empty and 'index.html' paths by changing line 27 to: if (!this.path || this.path === 'index.html') return true;

rawFindings.title: Regex for pagination page path in isHomeHelper is too permissive
rawFindings.explanation: The pagination regex was changed from '^pagination_dir/\d+/(index\.html)?$' to '^pagination_dir/\d+/', allowing any additional characters after the digit and slash, potentially matching unintended paths beyond the pagination dir structure.
rawFindings.suggestion: Revert the regex to include end anchors to ensure full path matching: '^' + escapeRegExp(paginationDir) + '\/\d+\/(index\.html)?$'
